newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican rebels carry out propaganda campaign.
newsitem.headline: Mexican rebels carry out propaganda campaign.

text.p: A group of well-armed Marxist rebels appeared in a small town in the western state of Guerrero Monday to peacefully distribute propaganda among residents, a radio report said.

Mexico City's Radio Red said 15 members of the Popular Revolutionary Amry (EPR) carrying AK-47 automatic rifles and wearing hoods turned up in the town of El Paraiso, some 170 miles (270 km) south of Mexico City.
They made speeches denouncing the government and handed out leaflets urging people to join the guerrilla group, Radio Red said, quoting Guerrero state police.
Guerrero state officials could not be reached for comment on the report.
The EPR which first appeared in mid-1996 and is credited by police with killing about 30 people.
Rebel leaders claim the ERP is currently waging a peaceful propaganda campaign.
